installError.title: The bot was not added to your server
installError.token_exchange_failed: Discord refused the bot's sign-in. The most common cause is a wrong Discord client secret. Check the client ID and client secret in Admin > Providers, then try again.
installError.token_endpoint_unreachable: The bot could not reach Discord. Check the server's internet connection, then try again.
installError.credentials_unconfigured: The Discord app is not set up yet. An admin enters the client ID and client secret in Admin > Providers first.
installError.access_denied: You pressed cancel on Discord's page, so nothing was added. Press Try again when you want to add the bot.
installError.authorization_failed: Discord did not approve the request. Press Try again and accept the permissions on Discord's page.
installError.invalid_state: This sign-in link expired or was already used. Start again with Try again, and finish it in one go.
installError.no_access_token: Discord answered without a sign-in token. Try again. If it keeps happening, check the Discord app in the developer portal.
installError.no_guild: Discord did not say which server you chose. Try again and pick a server on Discord's page.
installError.guild_link_failed: Discord approved the bot, but saving the link to your server failed. Try again. If it keeps failing, tell an admin to check the bot's log.
installError.unknown: The Discord install did not finish. Try again. If it keeps failing, tell an admin.
